 Add to Cal Travis Scott, Rockstar Games, and Nike are reportedly preparing a collaborative Air Force 1 collection to coincide with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. According to early release information, the project will feature three colorways of the Nike Air Force 1 Low, with a November 19, 2026 release date currently listed.
 The reported lineup includes Black/Fire Pink , White/Fire Pink , and Multicolor . Each pair is expected to retail for $130, with the collection falling under the Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike collaboration. Official images and design details have yet to surface, leaving the exact execution of the three pairs unknown.
 The collaboration also follows Travis Scott’s musical involvement with the upcoming game. The rapper released “RHYNO” on September 17 as part of the rollout for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album . Produced by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo of Daft Punk, the track is one of six original singles released ahead of the 34-track soundtrack, which is scheduled to arrive alongside the game.
 With Scott now connected to the project through both music and the reported footwear collaboration, the Air Force 1 collection adds another element to GTA 6’s growing cultural rollout.
 Neither Nike, Rockstar Games, nor Travis Scott has officially announced the sneaker collaboration. However, all three colorways are currently reported for November 19, with further details expected to emerge closer to release.
 For more on GTA VI, the collaborative Playstation 5 DualSense controllers are available now for pre-order.
